jobs.title: Business Analyst (Salesforce)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

We’re Dealer Tire, a family-owned, international distributor of tires and parts established in 1918 in Cleveland, OH. We’re laser focused on helping the world’s largest and most trusted auto manufacturers grow their tire business—in fact, we’ve sold more than 60 million tires to date. We’re a thriving company, and we’re looking for driven individuals to join our team. That’s where you come in!

Base Pay Range

$81,000 - $106,000

Broad Function And Objective (not Limited To)

Responsible for functional business analysis, requirements definition, and validation for IT projects. Functions in the Business Analyst role on assigned projects to document, test and communicate detailed business requirements, particularly for a Salesforce enterprise team. Delivers system knowledge about new workflow processes. Follows business analysis standards and guidelines and monitors compliance. Functions in the Project Manager role on assigned projects to create timelines, execute activities, and drive project deadlines.

As a Business Analyst - Salesforce, your essential job functions will include the following:

Business Process Analysis And Process/System Expertise

Developing breadth and depth of knowledge, both Salesforce and other systems and process, in assigned functional area(s) and product(s), with a holistic view across broad processes and systems.
Recommending and developing business process improvements for assigned area.
Analyzing cross-functional impact of business and systems processes across organizations.
Working with users to identify and recommend desired process modifications and enhancements.
Documenting and modeling business processes and associated data, including both “as-is” current processes and “to-be” improved processes.
Delivery of system knowledge on projects to new and existing users of new workflow processes and Information Technology system and products.
Keeping customers informed of business analysis work progress.
Meeting regularly with customers and IT Management to discuss, prioritize and report on application enhancements.
Maintaining and enforcing existing technology and documentation strategy

Customer Support Services

Responding to incident requests within established Dealer Tire Service Level Agreements
Engaging users in reporting the issues; timely response back to users; engaging other IT resources as needed, documenting issue resolution; analysis of patterns and trends within the requests; properly coding time spent; closing the user tickets according to the agreed timeframes.
Working with appropriate IT resources to implement process and system improvements to reduce/eliminate root causes of incidents.
Providing system knowledge transfer to functional super users and help desk support.

Project / Portfolio Management

Act as a trusted advisor for internal customers, aligning business priorities that require IT resources.
Create and maintain system roadmaps for internal customers.
Developing project timelines, milestones, and deliverables for assigned projects within defined high-level parameters of cost, time, and scope.
Applying change management procedures on projects to control scope.
Communicating issues and resolution timelines to meet project dates, escalating to IT Management when appropriate.
Providing overall project status to project stakeholders and IT Management
Conduct product demonstrations for current capabilities and coordinating overviews of potential future capabilities.

Requirements And Quality Management

Leading associates and management users in recording and communicating business requirements and defining acceptance criteria.
Working with associates to develop user acceptance test objectives, test plans and/or test scripts to verify and accept that business requirements have been met.
Executing system tests and user acceptance tests of system changes.

Work Management

Planning and estimating business analysis work as described above.
Facilitate and follow standard operating procedures for implementation of system changes.
Scheduling and coordinating ongoing and future development efforts.
Monitoring adherence to established business analysis standards and guidelines.
Meeting project quality, schedule, and cost commitments, under pressure
Other duties as assigned.

Position Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required.
Experience with Salesforce and other web technology.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
Minimum 3-5 years Salesforce business analysis experience.
Project Lead / Project Management experience preferred.
Strong communication skills to multiple levels of the organization.
Microsoft Excel, Word, Project. Visio.
Jira / Atlassian / Confluence experience a plus
Facilitation and negotiation skills.
Ability to manage in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Demands

Continuous viewing from and inputting data to a computer screen.
Sitting for long periods of time.
Travel as necessary (

Drug Policy

Dealer Tire is a drug-free environment. All applicants being considered for employment must pass a pre-employment drug screening before beginning work.

This Position Is Targeted To Be Closed On

2026-11-13

Why Dealer Tire:
An amazing opportunity to join a growing organization, built on the efforts of hard working, innovative, and team-oriented people. The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and geographic location. The total compensation package may also include commission, bonus or profit sharing. We offer a competitive & comprehensive benefit package including: paid time off, medical, dental, vision, and 401k match (50% on the dollar up to 7% of employee contribution). For more information on our benefit offerings, please visit our Dealer Tire Family of Companies Benefits Highlights Booklet.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Senior Project Manager – Medicaid Technology & Operations

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager
to lead complex technology and operational initiatives within a large-scale Medicaid / healthcare environment
.

This role will oversee high-visibility projects involving enterprise systems, business operations, technology teams, executive stakeholders, and third-party partners. The Senior Project Manager will be responsible for driving projects from planning through implementation while ensuring scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, and business requirements remain effectively managed.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience managing large, complex technology or healthcare projects
, can operate effectively across both business and IT teams, and is comfortable working with senior leadership, vendors, and multiple stakeholder groups.

Candidates based anywhere in Hawaiʻi are strongly preferred.
Candidates located elsewhere in the Pacific Time Zone may also be considered.
This role requires the ability to consistently work hours aligned with the Hawaiʻi Time Zone (HST) and support business, technology, and stakeholder teams operating in Hawaiʻi.
Candidates should be comfortable adjusting their working schedule as needed to provide full coverage during Hawaiʻi business hours.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead planning and execution of complex, high-visibility technology and operational projects.
Manage project scope, objectives, schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies, and deliverables.
Translate business objectives into actionable project plans and delivery milestones.
Drive projects from initiation through implementation and successful closure.
Manage multiple concurrent priorities while maintaining visibility into overall project health.

Planning, Risk & Execution Management

Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, and financial tracking.
Monitor project performance and proactively identify schedule, scope, resource, or delivery risks.
Maintain risk, issue, action, and dependency tracking and drive items through resolution.
Adjust project plans and priorities as business or technical requirements evolve.
Ensure projects remain aligned with organizational goals and stakeholder expectations.

Business & Technology Coordination

Serve as a central coordination point between business teams, technology teams, leadership, and external partners.
Ensure business requirements are understood and appropriately reflected in delivered technology and operational solutions.
Facilitate cross-functional meetings, decision-making, issue resolution, and project governance.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and required decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, and third-party vendors.
Coordinate internal resources and external partners to ensure successful project execution.
Manage vendor deliverables, dependencies, timelines, and commitments as appropriate.
Escalate risks and issues when necessary and drive stakeholders toward resolution.

Financial & Executive Reporting

Develop and manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial reporting.
Track budget performance and identify potential variances or financial risks.
Prepare concise executive-level project status reporting.
Provide leadership with clear visibility into project progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions required.

Quality & Project Closure

Ensure project deliverables meet established quality and business requirements.
Support implementation readiness, transition, and operational handoff activities.
Lead project closure activities, including documentation, lessons learned, and final project reporting.

Experience

Required Qualifications

Significant experience managing large-scale, complex, or high-visibility projects.
Demonstrated experience leading projects involving both business and technology stakeholders.
Experience managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and executive communications.
Experience coordinating multiple teams, vendors, and stakeholder groups within complex organizations.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects or a portfolio of initiatives.

Healthcare / Medicaid Experience

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following environments are strongly preferred:

Medicaid or government-sponsored healthcare programs
Healthcare technology or healthcare operations
Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) or related enterprise platforms
Healthcare systems modernization or transformation
Health plan, payer, eligibility, enrollment, claims, provider, or benefits administration environments
Public-sector healthcare technology programs

Skills

Strong project leadership, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to lead complex initiatives across business, technical, executive, and vendor teams.
Strong risk, issue, dependency, and change management capabilities.
Ability to communicate complex project information clearly to executive leadership.
Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
Experience with Smartsheet or similar enterprise project management tools is preferred.

Education & Certifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
PMP or comparable advanced project management certification preferred.
Master’s degree is a plus.

Ideal Candidate

The strongest candidate will be a Senior Project Manager who has successfully led major healthcare, Medicaid, public-sector, or enterprise technology initiatives
and can immediately take ownership of complex projects involving business operations, technology teams, leadership, and outside partners.

Experience within a Medicaid, payer, healthcare technology, MMIS, or government healthcare environment
will be particularly valuable.

What Makes HTC A Great Place To Build Your Future

HTC Global Services wants you to join our team. Come build new things with us and advance your career. At HTC Global, you’ll collaborate with experts, work alongside clients, and be part of high-performing teams driving success together. You’ll have long-term opportunities to grow your career and develop skills in the latest emerging technologies.

At HTC Global Services, our employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits can include Group Health (Medical, Dental, and Vision), Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, 401(k) matching, Group Life and Disability insurance, Professional Development opportunities, Wellness programs, and a variety of other perks.

Our success as a company is built on inclusion and diversity. HTC Global Services is committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment, where every employee is treated with dignity and respect. We celebrate differences and believe that diverse cultures, perspectives, and skills drive innovation and success. HTC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a proud National Minority Supplier. We seek to empower each individual, fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, included, and respected.

jobs.title: PH - Project Manager
jobs.description:
Description

This role is under Immediate Hiring.

Working at Thinking Machines

Thinking Machines is a technology consultancy building AI & data platforms to solve high-impact problems for our clients. Our vision is a future where data-driven decision-making is a norm and where AI is used to support humans in making excellent decisions. To do that, we create data cultures, one organization at a time.

We’re a company made up of intellectually curious, civic-minded, forever-learning individuals. We believe that great data science products are built with care for people and that the best way to drive inclusive innovation is to start with a diverse team.

Our field of work is incredibly dynamic, so we want to work with people who are committed to growing with us. We want to hire people who can demonstrate an ability to learn, then provide personalized coaching, growth opportunities, and a great working environment to get them to world-class.

Role Description

As a Project Manager, you are key in the successful and timely delivery of our data science projects. As our operations expand, so does the number of projects and their complexity. We deliver strategic projects for some of the largest organizations in Southeast Asia and having a dedicated project manager will allow us to take on more projects while maintaining the level of commitment and quality that our clients have come to expect from us.

You will be the main point of contact for our clients, keeping them informed of relevant milestones, blockers, or changes that a project needs. It’s not good to over or under-inform, so the project manager must be able to cascade the right information to the relevant people at the appropriate time.

You will be in charge of the projects’ schedule, requirements backlog, and to-do lists. Expect to work with both internal and client teams, and sometimes even push back on them, to keep the project on track -- effectively communicating at varying levels of seniority and contexts is a must. You will be expected to systematically break down big, vague requests into smaller, more actionable tasks for our teams. As such, being able to consolidate information from various parties and craft next steps from them will be very important.

Internally, you will be establishing workflows for your project teams depending on various factors like the nature of the project and the working style of your members. You need to quickly identify and improve on things that don’t work, as well as document and codify the things that do as best practices. The Project Manager is expected to create appropriate protocols, remove blockers, and address risks in a timely fashion, so that your team works at maximum efficiency. You must be able to build a strong rapport with your project teams. Making sure the project is delivered successfully through tough times while keeping your team motivated and not burnt out will be one of your most important responsibilities.

Requirements

Qualifications and competencies

We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

3+ years of project management experience - You must have successfully shipped or completed technology-focused products or software development projects.
Strong external communication skills - One of your main responsibilities will be to communicate with our client and internal teams of varying seniority. Not all news will be good news, so you need to know how to handle all sorts of situations.
A burning desire to get things done - You are the number one champion of your project, and you can rally your teammates to complete things on the task board.
Great adaptability and flexibility - Project plans, no matter how meticulously made, will veer off-course one way or another. You need to change strategies as needed, and not be locked into one way of doing things.
Ability to deal with ambiguity - You may handle projects that deal with topics you’ve never encountered before. You need to know how to ask the right questions to the right people to make things sensible for you and the team.
Quick learning ability - We don’t expect you to be an expert on the ins and outs of a data science project, but we do expect you to fill in the gaps quickly. Do the research and ask questions! You'll be part of a very talented team, so make sure to learn something new every day.
Strong initiative - There are many things to do from all sides! See something you can help with but you haven’t been assigned to? Go ahead and do it!

Ideal Candidates Have Experience With

Product design
Executing Agile methodologies

Additionally, we are requiring candidates to be flexible and willing to accommodate periodic face-to-face meetings with clients within Metro Manila
. While Thinking Machines operates as a remote-first company, certain project phases will require in-person interactions. As the main point of contact in client projects, Project Managers are expected to be the first to attend these on-site meetings.

Benefits

We offer the following compensation and benefits:

Competitive salary — the compensation amount is positively correlated with the difficulty of the job, relevant experience, fit, and skill factors.
Hybrid Set-Up — Hybrid-remote means employees are required to come in an average of two days a week for client engagements and internal in-person days intended for collaboration, socials, and strategic planning.
Individual professional development budget — an annual budget for conferences, training courses, books, and software is available to sharpen your skills and build new ones to help you grow in your role.
Full health benefits — generous health insurance package upon hiring, with options to include dependents.
Apprenticeship and yearly performance reviews with the leadership team to discuss career and personal goals, job progress and any questions and concerns.

Mission

In a context of accelerated digital transformation, VINCI Construction Canada is seeking a professional who can act as a bridge between business teams, IT teams, internal communications, and frontline users. The role focuses on driving and facilitating the adoption of new digital tools, including employee platforms (intranet, mobile application, and collaboration solutions), SharePoint (Microsoft 365) environments, and the internal application portfolio, by combining project management, change management, communications, and user support.

Key Responsibilities

Lead change management initiatives throughout the entire lifecycle of digital projects, from planning and implementation to long term deployment, including adoption activities, satisfaction surveys, continuous improvement, and support during the operational ("run") phase.
Contribute to the successful rollout of the new employee ecosystem, including the intranet, mobile application, and SharePoint Online collaboration spaces.
Translate technical challenges and business priorities into clear, engaging messages tailored to diverse internal audiences.
Develop and execute communication and adoption plans, including internal campaigns, announcements, FAQs, user guides, leadership toolkits, and training materials.
Drive continuous improvement by facilitating workshops, gathering feedback and business requirements from field teams, and refining approaches to encourage sustainable adoption and usage of digital tools.
Prepare executive summaries and reports for senior leadership regarding project progress, risks, benefits realization, adoption metrics, and next steps.
Promote the responsible, secure, and effective use of digital tools and AI capabilities across the organization.
5 to 10 years of experience in project management, change management, internal communications, digital adoption, or organizational transformation
Strong understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, particularly SharePoint Online, Teams, and Viva Engage. Experience managing a corporate intranet is considered a significant asset
Comfortable working in IT environments and with collaboration platforms, agile methodologies, and basic cybersecurity concepts.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both French and English, with the ability to simplify and communicate complex topics effectively
Proven ability to engage and influence a wide range of stakeholders, including IT, Communications, HR, Operations, Leadership, frontline teams, and external partners
Strong analytical mindset, results orientation, and ability to leverage data, surveys, and performance indicators to measure adoption and improve outcomes
Passion for innovation, AI, and continuous process improvement, combined with a pragmatic, user-centric approach.

Your Future Benefits

Opportunity to become a shareholder through our Employee Share Ownership Program under preferred conditions.
Peace of mind for retirement with our competitive pension plan.60% discount on more than 30 activities organized annually by our Social Club.

Customized training and development programs.
Reimbursement of professional association membership fees.
Flexible work arrangements for eligible positions.
Free parking.

As a Localization Project Manager

Responsibilities

About the Team
Our Trust & Safety team's commitment is to keep our online community safe. Within Trust & Safety, our Law Enforcement Operations team (LEO), consists of the Emergency Response Team (ERT), the Child Safety Team (CST), the Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT), the Extreme Risk Operations Team (ERO) and the Intellectual Property Team (IP). These teams handle some of the most critical and time-sensitive operations on the platform.

About the Role
We are looking for a motivated, highly-analytical, and technically proficient Quality Program Manager . In this role, you will work with other internal teams to design, build, and scale a next-generation Quality Assurance (QA) and Compliance program. You will be responsible for safeguarding our most sensitive operational workflows—including Emergency Disclosures to Law Enforcement, standard Law Enforcement Disclosures, Child Safety operations (including NCMEC reporting), Extreme Risk Operations (ERO) and Intellectual Property (IP) Operations
You will leverage AI, machine learning, and automation to build automated auditing systems that continuously assess our end-to-end operational workflows help to detect anomalies or compliance risks in real-time, and drastically mitigate business, legal, and regulatory risks.

Responsibilities
- Architect the Quality Program in collaboration with cross functional partners: Design and implement a comprehensive scabable global quality framework specifically tailored for high-risk operations (LERT, ERT, CST, NCMEC reporting and IP operations).
- Build Automated QA Tools: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to design, develop, and deploy internal AI-driven quality monitoring and auditing tools.
- Implement Anomaly Detection: Build innovative, scaled methods to detect and address quality warning signals across our end workflows.
- Mitigate Critical Risks: Proactively identify systemic vulnerabilities to prevent high risk quality failures that could impact the integrity of our operations and stakeholder trust.
- Perform Root Cause Analysis: Lead deep-dive investigations into quality failures or "near-misses," identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive action plans.
- Create Data-Driven Insights: Build automated dashboards and reporting pipelines to provide leadership with real-time visibility into compliance health and quality trends.
- Maintain Feedback Loops: Translate automated QA findings into actionable feedback, partnering with Team Leads to update training materials, operational policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
- Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all quality processes strictly align with global data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), legal frameworks, and child safety regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Quality Assurance, Operational Risk, or Compliance, with at least 3 years specifically supporting Law Enforcement Response, Child Safety (CST), Emergency/Crisis Response operations and Intellectual Property Operations
- Hands-on technical proficiency with data and automation; strong, practical experience with SQL and Python (or similar scripting languages) to manipulate data, write basic automation scripts, and interface with engineering tools.

jobs.description:
How to Apply

A cover letter and resume are important submissions for the hiring team to get a sense of your experience. In the cover letter, in one page or less, please let us know how this role aligns with your career aspirations and skills. Submit both a cover letter and resume as one file.

Competitive salary available based on qualifications, experience and education of the selected candidate.

Job Summary

Information and Technology Services (ITS) at the University of Michigan-Ann Arbor is seeking a Senior Project Manager
to join the ITS Project Management Office. ITS supports the university's academic, research, and administrative missions by delivering secure, innovative, and reliable technology services across Ann Arbor, Michigan Medicine, and the Flint and Dearborn campuses.

We are looking for an experienced project management professional who thrives in a dynamic, rapidly evolving technology environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong customer service and relationship-building skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to think both strategically and tactically. This role requires effectively managing priorities, meeting deadlines, and ensuring the successful delivery of project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities Include

Delivering a wide variety of complex technology projects ranging from software development, IT infrastructure, vendor product implementation, and process transformation.
Ensuring successful project outcomes by partnering closely with cross-functional teams, sponsors, and stakeholders across both the Information Technology Services (ITS) organization and the entire university community.

This position reports directly to the VPIP-CIO Chief of Staff and IT Project Management Office Director.

Responsibilities*

Project Management

Oversee complex technology projects to ensure that they are completed on time, within budget, and according to agreed-upon scope and quality standards.
Ensure service owners are aware of and adhere to the ITS service life cycle process and have a plan to maintain the service after the project is completed.
Develop detailed project schedules, in collaboration with the project team, that account for all deliverables, workstreams, milestones, estimated effort, resource plans, and financial budgets.
Ensure a common understanding of project goals and outcomes with the project team and all project stakeholders.
Actively identify and anticipate potential risks, develop mitigation plans, and drive the resolution of project issues.
Apply organizational change management techniques to ensure successful project outcomes.
Form the project team and ensure that clearly defined roles and responsibilities are established for the duration of the project and the resulting operational outcomes.
Assess project performance with team members and stakeholders by identifying areas for improvement, implementing innovations, and leading corrective actions as necessary.
Ensure effective communication and collaboration across all project team members, ITS leadership, and project stakeholders. Deliver weekly project status reports and establish additional project communication tactics as necessary.
Build consensus. Challenge proposals when appropriate.
Demonstrate strong influencing and negotiation skills with the ability to lead project teams through creative problem-solving.
Establish and maintain trust, facilitate cooperation, and create strong relationships at all levels: customer, stakeholder, executive, management, and staff.
Demonstrate robust knowledge of IT principles, standards, and processes.

Strategy and Planning

Act as a trusted advisor to leadership and support future strategy outcomes.
Leverage data to guide decision-making, perform risk analysis, craft compelling stories that resonate with an executive audience, and present information to all levels through graphical representations.
Assess impacts and trade-offs of key decisions, including financial, customer, reputation, effort, and ongoing operations.

Leadership & Development of Self and Others

Ability to navigate complex and ambiguous circumstances to drive project progress.
Stay updated on relevant advances in business and technology; seek opportunities to diversify skills and experience.
Demonstrate continued development of new skills and knowledge. Ability to quickly get up to speed and lead a variety of projects without deep expertise.
Provide actionable feedback, motivation, and mentorship to less-experienced staff.
Build strong, cooperative relationships by interacting in an open, ethical, honest, and accepting manner.

Required Qualifications*

Bachelor's degree in a related field and/or equivalent combination of education, certification, and experience.
Minimum of 7 years of Information Technology (IT) experience, demonstrating responsibility for increasingly large or enterprise-wide initiatives.
Minimum of 5 years of project management experience, including leading project teams through all phases of projects and managing concurrent projects.
Significant knowledge and experience with various project management methodologies and tools.
Strong problem-solving capabilities with the ability to drive collaborative decisions.
Demonstrated understanding of and skills in client relationship management, organizational change management, systems analysis, team building, process improvement, and strategic planning.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively and build strong relationships with cross-functional project teams and a large number of project stakeholders.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with experience in executive-level communications.
Demonstrated ability to adapt to new circumstances quickly and utilize a variety of approaches when required.
Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and to understand technical information and communicate it to others using clear, concise, and user-friendly language.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or PRINCE2

Desired Qualifications*

Experience in Higher Education or Government
Experience using artificial intelligence tools
Experience with cloud vendor implementations
PgMP, PMI-ACP, or other certifications

Modes of Work

Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes.

Underfill Statement

UM- ITS welcomes a healthy applicant pool so we encourage all interested applicants to apply. This position may be underfilled at a lower classification depending on the qualifications of the selected candidate.

Additional Information

Benefits At The University Of Michigan

In addition to a career filled with purpose and opportunity, The University of Michigan offers a comprehensive benefits package to help you stay well, protect yourself and your family and plan for a secure future. Benefits include:

Generous time off
A retirement plan that provides two-for-one matching contributions with immediate vesting
Many choices for comprehensive health insurance
Life insurance
Long-term disability coverage
Flexible spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses
Dental and Vision Insurance
Parental and Maternity Leave

Application Deadline

Job openings are posted for at least seven calendar days. The review and selection process may begin as early as the eighth day after posting. This opening may be removed from posting boards and filled anytime after the minimum posting period has ended.

U-M EEO Statement

The University of Michigan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Project Manager
jobs.description:
Title:
Senior Engineering Project Manager

Company:
Heven AeroTech

Location:
Bingen, Washington

FLSA:
Exempt

About Our Company

At Heven AeroTech (Heven), we don’t just believe in the power of people—we build our success on it. As a recognized leader in hydrogen-powered drones, we’ve earned recognition for creating a workplace where innovation thrives, collaboration is second nature, and every employee feels valued. Our culture is anchored in trust and a shared commitment to excellence.

We believe great teams are built on individuals who are humble, hungry, and smart—those who put team success first, take initiative to continuously improve, and demonstrate strong interpersonal awareness. At Heven, your voice matters, your ideas are heard, and your contributions make a tangible impact as you grow through hands-on experience and collaboration across the team.

Role Summary

Heven AeroTech is seeking a Senior Engineering Project Manager to plan, coordinate, and drive the technical execution of our unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) engineering programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and program management: you will own the integrated technical schedule, translate systems engineering and design requirements into executable work plans, and keep multidisciplinary engineering teams (airframe, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload) aligned against cost, schedule, and technical performance targets. Beyond running individual programs, you will build and continuously improve the engineering project management processes, tools, and gating criteria that the broader organization uses to deliver UAS hardware and software from concept through flight test and production. Success in this role requires genuine technical fluency — the ability to read requirements and drawings, understand test data, and engage credibly in engineering design reviews — combined with strong program management discipline.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead technical project management for one or more UAS engineering programs, spanning airframe/structures, propulsion, avionics, flight software, and payload integration workstreams.
Develop and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS), work breakdown structure (WBS), and critical path analysis; proactively identify schedule risk and drive recovery plans.
Partner with systems engineering to translate requirements, interface control documents, and verification plans into actionable engineering task plans and staffing assignments.
Plan and facilitate technical design reviews and program milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, flight readiness reviews), including agenda development, entrance/exit criteria, and action item tracking to closure.
Own program-level technical risk and opportunity management: identify, quantify, track, and drive mitigation of engineering risks in coordination with discipline leads.
Manage engineering change requests and configuration control in support of the company's design change (PDCR) process, ensuring changes are scoped, reviewed, and communicated to affected teams.
Develop, standardize, and continuously improve engineering project management processes, templates, and tools (scheduling, requirements traceability, risk registers, metrics/dashboards) across programs.
Manage program technical budget and resource allocation; support staffing plans and headcount forecasting in coordination with engineering leads.
Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and test/flight operations to ensure engineering deliverables support build, integration, and flight test schedules.
Interface directly with internal leadership and external customers/partners to communicate technical status, risks, and trade-offs; prepare and deliver program reviews and status reporting.
Support compliance with applicable engineering standards, airworthiness, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FAA Part 107/UAS regulations, relevant MIL-STD or RTCA/DO guidance) as they apply to program execution.
Drive lessons-learned capture and process retrospectives at program milestones to feed continuous improvement of engineering execution practices.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required to perform the responsibilities of this role.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
If this role requires access to information controlled under U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR), applicants must also qualify as a "U.S. person" under 22 CFR
120.62 (U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee).
Other duties as assigned.

Required

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
4–10 years of experience in engineering project management, technical program management, or systems engineering, ideally within UAS, aerospace, or defense product development.
Demonstrated technical fluency: able to read and interpret engineering drawings, requirements documents, interface control documents, and test/analysis data well enough to plan work and challenge technical assumptions.
Proven experience building and maintaining integrated schedules (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet) and work breakdown structures for multidisciplinary hardware/software programs.
Experience managing technical risk registers, action item tracking, and design review gating (PDR/CDR-type milestones).
Track record of developing or improving engineering project management processes, templates, or tools within an organization.
Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting technical status to engineering leadership and customers.
Working knowledge of configuration management and engineering change control processes.

Preferred

Master's degree in an engineering discipline or a technical MBA.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification.
Direct experience on UAS, drone, or other aerospace/defense flight vehicle programs.
Familiarity with systems engineering lifecycle practices (requirements management, V&V/test planning, MBSE tools).
Experience with PLM/ALM tooling (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, Jira, Confluence) and requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama).
Familiarity with FAA UAS regulations, airworthiness processes, or relevant military/commercial aviation standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-160, MIL-STD-810).
Experience with earned value management (EVM) or similar program performance metrics

Physical Requirements

Ability to work in both office and engineering lab environments for extended periods.
Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for prolonged periods throughout the workday.
Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds of engineering equipment, prototypes, test hardware, or program materials.
Ability to attend and participate in engineering design reviews, manufacturing floor activities, integration events, and flight test operations.
Ability to travel domestically up to 20% of the time, with occasional international travel as required.
Ability to access manufacturing, test, and flight operations environments, including navigating hangars, workshops, and outdoor test sites.
Ability to visually inspect engineering drawings, schedules, technical documentation, hardware, and test data.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through virtual collaboration tools.

Benefits Overview

Heven AeroTech offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, financial security, and overall well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits in protectional, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off/sick, and additional protections such as critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, and short- and long-term disability.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Heven AeroTech is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

Our Global Accounting Process Excellence team is a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of finance operations and cutting-edge technology. We build real solutions — Python scripts, RPA workflows, AI agents — that save our global accounting teams hours of manual work every week.

We're looking for a hands-on technical Business Analyst who loves building things, not just documenting them. You'll work directly with our global accounting teams (Germany, Sofia, Mexico) to understand their pain points and turn them into automated, AI-enabled solutions — using Python, RPA tools, and AI agents as your primary toolkit.

You'll be the first direct report to our lead of Digital Process Automation function — a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership end-to-end, and is excited to be part of building something from the ground up.

About The Role

Build automation solutions: Develop and deploy practical automations using Python, n8n, UiPath and approved AI technologies — including workflow logic, system integrations, and exception handling
Develop AI-enabled features: Build applied AI components using LLM services (Claude or equivalent), structured outputs, tool calling, and agent workflows — with clear, measurable business value
Create data processing pipelines: Write Python and SQL-based solutions for reconciliations, validations, data transformations, and operational controls
Integrate enterprise systems: Work with REST APIs, JSON, databases, files and connectors to integrate with enterprise systems such as Oracle Fusion and automate end-to-end processes
Use AI-assisted development tools: Leverage tools like Claude Code to accelerate prototyping, testing, and deployment — build MVPs fast, validate with users, and evolve into maintainable solutions
Own production readiness: Implement proper testing, access management, error handling, logging, and audit trails — you ship things that actually work in production
Maintain and improve: Take long-term ownership of delivered solutions; coordinate with platform, security, and tech teams as needed
Translate business to technical: Engage directly with accounting stakeholders, understand manual processes, and independently define the right automation approach

About You

3+ years of hands-on experience in automation, technical business analysis, or solution delivery, with strong, production-ready Python skills and experience building maintainable, robust applications —not just one-off scripts.
Automation & RPA experience — practical hands-on work with at least one workflow or RPA tool such as UiPath, n8n, or equivalent
Integration & API skills — experience building reliable system integrations using REST APIs, including authentication, data exchange, error handling, and troubleshooting.
Practical AI/LLM exposure — you've actually built something using an AI tool, agent, or LLM framework — not just read about it
Independent delivery mindset — you take a problem from definition to working, deployed solution without handholding; fluent English and comfortable working in Central European business hours

A Strong Advantage

Finance & enterprise platform knowledge — exposure to accounting processes (GL, AP, AR, reconciliations, invoice processing) and/or enterprise tools like Oracle Fusion, Snowflake, or Power BI
AI agent frameworks & cloud basics — familiarity with LangChain / Mastra agentic AI frameworks, MCP, and similar; cloud deployment (AWS/Azure), containerization, or CI/CD experience is a bonus; Engineering/CS degree with certifications in Data Science, AI, or RPA (e.g. UiPath Developer Certification) is a plus

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer

Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.

Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Our Mission and Opportunity

Early education is one of the most important determinants of childhood outcomes, a critical support for working families, and a $175B market that remains underserved by modern technology. Brightwheel is the largest, fastest growing, and most loved platform in early ed, trusted by millions of educators and families every day. We are a three-time Cloud 100 company, backed by top investors including Addition, Bessemer, Emerson Collective, Lowercase Capital, Notable Capital, and Mark Cuban.

Our Team

Our team is passionate, talented, and customer-focused. We embody our Leadership Principles in our work and culture. We are a distributed team with remote employees across every US time zone, as well as select offices in the US and internationally.

Who You Are

You are a highly analytical and technically proficient Senior Data Analyst
with a proven track record of using data to inform decision-making in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. As a natural problem-solver, you excel at translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You've played a key role supporting the analytics function in a high-growth environment at a prior company, leveraging AI
to drive business outcomes.

You are a generalist at heart — equally comfortable partnering with Finance to reconcile operating and financial views, standing up reporting for external partners, and stitching the full customer lifecycle into a single narrative for leadership. You've earned the trust of leadership and external stakeholders by holding a high bar for accuracy.

What You’ll Do

You are primarily responsible for Finance and Post-Sales analytics — owning the reporting layer that bridges Sales and Post-Sales, and producing the board-ready and externally-facing reporting our leadership team and government partners depend on.
Partner directly with Finance and senior leadership to build, validate, and own the metrics that feed board reporting, AOP planning, and monthly/quarterly business reviews — including MRR/ARR, churn and retention, and revenue attribution across customer segments.
Serve as the connective tissue between Sales and Post-Sales reporting, building a consistent view of the customer lifecycle from pipeline through activation, retention, and expansion, and resolving definitional gaps between the two.
Own our external partnership reporting portfolio end-to-end, including customer-facing dashboards — translating partner data requirements into models and dashboards, and ensuring the data we hand to an external audience is accurate, appropriately permissioned, and self-service.
Build, automate, and maintain dashboards and reports in our BI tools (Sigma + Tableau) to track key cross-funnel KPIs for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

What You’ve Done

4+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a relevant technical role — preferably with Finance, Fintech, BizOps, or Retention domain experience.
Advanced proficiency in core technical analytics, including SQL (writing complex queries and manipulating data), Data Transformation (maintaining data models with tools like dbt), and Business Intelligence/Visualization with tools like Sigma or Tableau.
Demonstrated experience in creating and maintaining data models and pipelines end-to-end that served as the single source of truth.
A history of building and owning a suite of dashboards and reports in a BI tool, consistently delivering valuable insights to business stakeholders.
Excellent communication skills for stakeholder management, including acting as a trusted consultant and effectively translating technical information for all levels of an organization.
Demonstrated fluency using AI to fundamentally change how you work — not just to speed up tasks, but to automate routine workflows, accelerate analyses, and build reusable tools and data infrastructure.
Bonus: Experience with Salesforce.

This role must be available for work during standard US working hours (any 8-hour shift from 9am EST - 8pm EST).

Brightwheel is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Protecting Our Applicants: Please be aware of recruiting scams impersonating Brightwheel. All legitimate communications come from @
mybrightwheel.com
addresses, and we never ask for payment or sensitive personal data as part of our hiring process. If you suspect fraudulent contact, reach out to security@mybrightwheel.com
. Thank you for helping us keep our applicant community safe.

Experience with Tableau specifically

About Elevait

Elevait Solutions was founded by veterans who believe that how you treat people is the only thing that actually matters in this industry. We're a team that stays in your corner before, during, and after placement. We show up for the communities we work in, we tell you the truth, and we work hard to make sure every placement is a good fit for both sides. If that sounds like the kind of team you want behind you, we'd like to talk.

Elevait is a certified Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We have over 100,000 LinkedIn followers, and Elevait was named a top company for hiring veterans by U.S. Veterans Magazine. We would rather you check us out yourself than just take our word for it, so look us up on our website and on LinkedIn.

Pay Transparency

New York requires pay range disclosure for this posting. The pay range for this position is $23.41 to $29.00 per hour, based on qualifications and experience.

CRNGJP00030004

analytics, dashboards, reporting, visualization, governance, quality, insights, metrics, statistics, data, BI, KPI

Internal Market Recap
(client: Corning Incorporated, Sullivan Park campus, Painted Post/Corning NY)

Pay Positioning
Max bill rate on this req is $42.87/hr, and the candidate-facing rate given is up to $29/hr, near the top of Magnit's own suggested $23.41 to $28.58 range (actually slightly above it at $29). For a Data Analyst 2 role of this scope (BI tools, dashboarding, cross functional support, 1 to 5 years experience) in the Corning/Elmira, NY market, this lands roughly in line with the median to slightly above for similar analyst roles in upstate NY. It is not a rate that will struggle badly, but it is not a standout either. If you're struggling to find qualified people at this rate, here's what to consider loosening: move the specific tool preference (Power BI vs. Tableau vs. JMP/Python) fully to "proficiency in at least one" rather than expecting multiple, and consider relaxing the years of experience floor toward the lower end of the 1 to 5 range before touching anything in Top 3 Skills.

Competitive Landscape
Local/regional talent pool around Corning and Elmira, NY: Corning Incorporated itself (other divisions), IEC Electronics, Hilliard Corporation, Willow Run Foods, Guthrie Clinic (data/analytics roles), Elmira Savings Bank, Chemung Financial Corporation, Watson Homes. Broader upstate NY/regional peer employers doing similar data analyst work: Corning's own competitors in materials science and advanced manufacturing such as 3M, Owens Corning, and Saint Gobain, plus general BI/data analyst employers in the Rochester/Syracuse corridor like Paychex, Excellus BlueCross BlueShield, and Wegmans.

Contractor vs. FTE Trends
No client specific Contract to FTE pattern on file yet for Corning. Using the general heuristic: most Elevait contract engagements carry a strong track record of extending and converting toward full time, though nothing is guaranteed. This req runs roughly a full year (09/14/2026 to 08/27/2027), which is a long initial term and suggests a legitimate ongoing need rather than a short term project, so frame it with the candidate as a contract with a real trajectory toward extension or conversion, not a hard stop at the end date.

Selling Points & Watch-Outs
Selling points: this is a well funded innovation program at a large, established materials science company, giving the analyst visibility into R&D decision making rather than routine back office reporting. The role offers exposure to multiple BI tools rather than being locked into one platform. Long contract duration signals stability. Watch-outs: fully onsite, five days a week, with no remote flexibility, which will be a dealbreaker for some candidates. Local candidates only, so this will not work for anyone needing relocation. Shortlisting is happening fast, candidates need to be ready to move by Friday, August 14 in the afternoon.

Candidate Profile
Realistic candidate has an Associate's or Bachelor's degree in a data, analytics, or business related field, 1 to 5 years of hands on experience building dashboards and reports, and is currently working as a data analyst, BI analyst, or reporting analyst, likely in a manufacturing, corporate, or R&D support function. They are comfortable presenting findings to non technical stakeholders and are not necessarily a heavy coder, more tool proficient than a data scientist.

Sourcing Channels
Source on LinkedIn Recruiter using zip code plus radius around Corning, NY 14831 rather than city name stacking given the smaller local market. Target BI and reporting analyst profiles at the competitive landscape companies above, especially Corning's other divisions and regional manufacturing or healthcare employers with analytics teams. Also check general Data Analyst and Business Intelligence Analyst searches restricted to the Elmira, Corning, and greater Southern Tier NY area, since the local pool is small and this role does not require a niche technical background.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Veteran Workforce Solutions is a leading organization dedicated to supporting the transition of military service members into civilian careers. With a strong emphasis on workforce development and skill enhancement, the company partners with various industry leaders to create meaningful employment opportunities for veterans. Their mission is to bridge the gap between military experience and civilian job markets by providing targeted training, mentorship, and career placement services. Veteran Workforce Solutions prides itself on fostering an inclusive environment that values discipline, technical expertise, and leadership qualities inherent in military personnel, ensuring they find rewarding roles that leverage their unique skills and experiences.

About The Role

The Cybersecurity Analyst internship offered through Veteran Workforce Solutions is an immersive 16-week SkillBridge program designed specifically for transitioning service members with backgrounds in cyber operations, signals intelligence, or IT. Participants will gain practical, hands-on experience working alongside civilian cybersecurity professionals within a reputable employer partner organization. The role involves supporting critical security functions such as threat detection, vulnerability management, and incident response, all under the mentorship of industry experts. This position provides a comprehensive pathway into the cybersecurity field, emphasizing skill development, industry certifications, and potential full-time employment upon successful completion. The program aims to equip participants with the technical acumen and professional readiness needed to excel in the rapidly evolving cybersecurity landscape.

Qualifications

Active-duty service members within 180 days of separation or retirement are eligible to apply.
Must have approval from the unit commanding officer to participate in the DoD SkillBridge program.
Background in cyber operations, signals intelligence, IT systems, or network administration is preferred.
Relevant Military Occupational Specialty (MOS), rate, or Air Force Specialty Code (AFSC): 17C, 25B, 35Q, CTN, 1B4, 3D0X2, 1N4, 0651.
Active Secret clearance is preferred but not required.
Ability to operate effectively in remote or hybrid work environments.
No prior civilian cybersecurity certification is necessary; training and certifications will be provided during the program.

Responsibilities

Participants will work closely with seasoned cybersecurity professionals to support a variety of security operations. Key responsibilities include monitoring security alerts and logs to identify potential threats, managing Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, conducting vulnerability scans to identify system weaknesses, and assisting in incident response activities to mitigate security breaches. The role involves participating in threat hunting exercises and simulated incident response scenarios to develop practical skills. Throughout the program, participants will engage in structured training modules covering the cybersecurity threat landscape, SOC operations, vulnerability management, and industry-standard certifications such as CompTIA Sec+, CEH, or CISSP. The participant will also prepare a capstone project, such as a threat hunt or incident response simulation, demonstrating their ability to apply learned skills in real-world scenarios. Regular performance reviews and mentorship sessions will support personal and professional growth, culminating in a debrief and employment discussion at the program’s conclusion.

Benefits

Participants in the Cybersecurity Analyst SkillBridge program will gain valuable industry experience, technical skills, and professional certifications that enhance their employability in the cybersecurity sector. The program offers networking opportunities with industry professionals and potential full-time employment upon successful completion. Additionally, veterans will receive mentorship and guidance from experienced cybersecurity experts, helping to establish a solid foundation for a career in cybersecurity. The organization also provides resources for career development, resume building, and interview preparation. As a participant, you will be part of a supportive community committed to your success, with access to ongoing training and educational opportunities designed to keep your skills current in this dynamic field.

Equal Opportunity

Veteran Workforce Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and program participants. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Our commitment is to provide equal access to employment, training, and development opportunities, ensuring all individuals have the chance to succeed and grow within our organization and partner networks.

The AI Data and Safety team plays a critical role in advancing Seed's foundational models, AI products across modalities, and improving AI-native applications built on the Seed model series. As more large AI models are being developed, high-quality data has become the core fuel driving the leap in model capabilities. Our team – AI Data & Safety – Data Annotation and Evaluation Operations – is the builder and operator of this critical link.

Our value lies in transforming the "intelligence" scattered across individual experience and organizational knowledge into "data" that models can understand and learn from by establishing a scientific and efficient data production and operation system. This directly drives the iteration of model capabilities and the implementation of various AI applications. We serve not only as key infrastructure supporting ByteDance’s AI strategy, but also as the core bridge connecting human wisdom and machine intelligence.

Your Role Will Involve:

Project Management: Lead and manage data annotation, evaluation, and/or user growth projects for various AI product modalities (LLM, VLM, Speech or Video) across multiple General, STEM, or non-STEM academic topics. jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Global Head of Sustainability

In our new Robotics company, you will strengthen Sustainability’s analytical backbone by building data models, templates, and dashboards that measure performance across climate, circularity, waste, water, energy and materials. You will help set up efficient tools and methods (Power BI, Excel, shared templates), ensure data quality, and enable clear insights for decision‑making across the business. You will also help digitalize and automate our processes, strengthen analytics and decision-making.

This role is part of ABB’s Robotics business, it bridges IT and sustainability, requiring someone who can code, communicate, and think strategically about data governance.

By joining us now, you’ll be part of a dynamic and fast-paced organization at the forefront of robotics innovation. As we transition into a separate entity outside the ABB Group, you’ll have the chance to shape the future, grow your career, and work alongside world-class experts in a more agile and entrepreneurial environment.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This is a global role; the preferred locations are: Krakow or Västerås, with flexibility for the right candidate

Your Responsibilities

Build Enterprise Analytics Solutions – Develop and maintain scalable dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, Snowflake, and Streamlit that track Scope 1–3 emissions, circularity, waste, water, energy, and key sustainability KPIs with advanced data modelling and interactive visualizations
Standardize Data Frameworks & Templates – Design and implement reusable data collection processes, templates, and standards across Sustainability, Operations, Supply Chain, HR, Finance, and R&D to ensure consistency, quality, and audit readiness
Bridge IT & Sustainability – Translate sustainability business needs into data requirements; collaborate with IS/IT on toolchain decisions, connectors, and data infrastructure while representing the sustainability perspective
Ensure Data Integrity & Governance – Set up efficient validation, transformation, and refresh cycles; document calculation rules and assumptions; run quality checks to maintain audit-ready datasets and reliable decision-making
Enable Trend Analysis & Insights – Support topic leads with ad hoc analyses, scenario modelling (e.g., decarbonization pathways), and performance dashboards that drive strategy and accountability across the business

Essential Skills

Qualifications for the role:

Baschelors/ Masters degree in Data/Analytics, Engineering, Sustainability or a related field
 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics consulting
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing concepts, master data management, and building scalable reporting architectures; experience designing data validation frameworks and quality assurance processes
 Demonstrated experience managing and reporting ESG metrics, emissions accounting (Scope 1, 2, 3), circularity, waste, water, and sustainability KPIs; familiarity with building templates for multi-stakeholder data collection
Proven ability to explain complex technical analyses to non-experts, work effectively in multicultural teams, and adapt quickly as tools, priorities, and business needs evolve; fluency in English
Advanced proficiency in Power BI or Tableau, SQL for data querying and transformation, Python or R for scripting and automation, and expert-level Excel (data modeling, pivot tables, automation) is a plus.
Excellent communication skills in English

Data quality focused – You validate assumptions, document logic, and catch issues early.
Systems thinker – You understand data flows and downstream impacts.
Self-sufficient builder – You prototype practical solutions independently.
Clear communicator – You explain technical topics clearly to non-experts.
Adaptable – You stay effective as needs, tools, and priorities change.
Collaborative – You partner well with IT while representing sustainability needs.

Company Description

ABOUT IQ-EQ

We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.

Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. 

We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

Job Description

THIS ROLE

An experienced preparer role responsible for handling a broader range of routine ETL and data processing activities using established procedures and prescribed guidelines. The role performs pre‑validation checks, documents exceptions for escalation, and prepares draft inputs for senior review. It requires working knowledge of data processes, growing familiarity with client-specific requirements, and the ability to deliver accurate outputs with moderate guidance while supporting continuous improvements through observations.

What You Will Do

You’ll perform ETL activities across a range of routine data sources, preparing, extracting, transforming, and validating data in accordance with established procedures, templates, and quality standards.
You’ll prepare recurring report inputs, draft report components, and conduct pre-validation and consistency checks to identify discrepancies, ensuring timely escalation of issues when required.
You’ll maintain a strong understanding of client-specific requirements, support routine data-related inquiries, and coordinate effectively with internal teams to ensure accurate and timely deliverables.
You’ll contribute to quality assurance by documenting exceptions, maintaining reference files, following control procedures, completing required checklists, and escalating risks or non-standard cases in line with established protocols.
You’ll support operational efficiency through onboarding activities, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, accurate timesheet completion, and participation in process improvement discussions by identifying recurring issues and opportunities for refinement.

What We Offer

Comprehensive remuneration: Competitive financial packages based upon market rates for your role, proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
Pension Scheme: Generous employer contribution with the ability to increase employee contributions
Wellbeing: Additional social benefits such as medical insurance & life assurance, discounted gym memberships and the opportunity to engage with our local community via sports activities, charity programmes & environmental initiatives
Flexible working: We recognise the value of working flexibly and enable our employees to enjoy an excellent work-life blend
Support and development: We will ensure you have the right training, tools and development plan to grow and improve your skills every day.

Qualifications

ABOUT YOU

You hold a bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or a related field, with at least 3 years of experience in data analysis, ETL processes, data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), and Macro/VBA.
You have strong expertise in data extraction, transformation, and analysis, including handling complex or unstructured data, troubleshooting technical issues, and applying MS SQL/Data Warehouse concepts in moderately complex scenarios.
You are proficient in data visualization and storytelling best practices, with advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to support dashboard integrity, reporting accuracy, and continuous enhancements.
You possess strong communication, organizational, and prioritization skills, enabling you to explain technical concepts, provide guidance to preparers, manage multiple responsibilities, and work effectively with minimal supervision.
You are a proactive, detail-oriented, and collaborative professional who contributes to process improvements, identifies and mitigates risks, mentors junior team members, and remains committed to continuous learning, quality standards, and industry best practices.

Additional Information

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.
