Job Overview:

Job Title: Sr. Financial Data Analyst, Corporate FP&A

This role is specific to the current Coffee Operating Unit of KDP.  Following the recent, successful acquisition of JDE Peet’s in April 2026, the Coffee Operating Unit will become its own independent publicly traded company.  For more information on this, please visit keurigdrpepper.com  Summary:

Keurig Dr Pepper is seeking a hands-on, experienced Sr. Financial Data Analyst to join its Corporate FP&A team. This role is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and is motivated by the opportunity to expand their influence across the organization while growing personally and professionally. The position requires a process-oriented leader who can partner effectively with the financial management team to provide decision support, identify savings opportunities, and improve productivity across the organization.

Role Overview:

As a Sr. Financial Data Analyst, you will be responsible for interpreting complex financial data, creating insightful reports, reconciling systems, driving process improvements, supporting the Financial Product Owner in financial data product development, and communicating effectively with stakeholders across the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Interpretation and Modeling Support

Perform ad hoc projects and analyses using varied and complex datasets.
Develop financial models and analyses using advanced analytical tools and multiple reporting systems; provide accessible insights, projections, and decision-support materials with appropriate guidance.
Drive financial process improvements related to information management, model governance, and reporting efficiency.
Maintain complex information models and support end users with financial data extraction, reporting, and analysis.

System and Financial Reconciliation

Collect, clean, and organize financial data from various sources, including databases and enterprise reporting systems.
Reconcile detailed datasets across multiple source systems using independently developed models and validation processes.
Troubleshoot system inconsistencies and partner with IT and operational stakeholders to resolve discrepancies.

Project Management and Stakeholder Communication

Partner with cross-functional teams to lead financial planning and reporting system integration efforts across the global Coffee organization.
Partner with the Product Owner to define product strategy, prioritize business value, and support the delivery of new financial data capabilities.
Participate in Agile ways of working and support cross-functional collaboration throughout development cycles.
Prepare comprehensive reports and dashboards that communicate key findings, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders. Use data visualization tools to present complex information clearly and concisely.
Gather business and development requirements and translate them into actionable product roadmap items.
Create compelling, visually engaging PowerPoint presentations that translate complex data, insights, and strategic recommendations into clear executive-ready narratives.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Total Rewards:

Salary Range: $76,400 - $ 100,000
Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factors
Benefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Paid Time Off (including paid parental leave, vacation, and sick time), 401k with company match, Tuition Reimbursement, and Mileage Reimbursement
Annual bonus based on performance and eligibility

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field;
2+ years of experience in financial analysis, data analytics, problem-solving, or analytical decision support.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint required.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively while managing multiple priorities and parallel workstreams.

Company Overview:

Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) is a leading beverage company with more than 150 owned, licensed and partner brands that meet a wide range of needs and occasions. Our North American refreshment beverage business holds leadership positions across carbonated soft drinks, water, juice and mixers with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Mott’s®, A&W®, Peñafiel®, GHOST®, 7UP®, Snapple®, Clamato® and Core Hydration®. Our global coffee business spans more than 100 markets and includes the leading Keurig® single-serve brewing system in the U.S. and Canada, along with powerhouse brands such as Peet’s, L’OR and Jacobs, and other regional coffee leaders. Our more than 50,000 employees aim to enhance the experience of every beverage and coffee occasion while making a positive impact for people, communities, and the planet.

We strive to be an employer of choice, providing culture and opportunities that empower our team to grow and develop. We offer robust benefits to support your health and wellness as well as your personal and financial well-being. We also provide employee programs designed to enhance your professional growth and development, while ensuring you feel valued, inspired and appreciated at work.

Whatever your area of expertise, at KDP you can be a part of a team that’s proud of its brands, partnerships, innovation and growth. Will you join us?

Keurig Dr Pepper is an equal opportunity employer and recruits qualified applicants and advances in employment its employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability or association with a person with a disability, medical condition, genetic information, ethnic or national origin, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Bridge
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About The Team

Join our Technical Program Management team to build the systems that make global, programmable money trustworthy at scale. At Bridge, we’re not just improving global payments—we’re reinventing how money moves across borders using stablecoins and modern financial infrastructure.

This role is about driving execution across complex technical initiatives—bringing structure to ambiguous problems, aligning stakeholders, and helping the team move quickly while maintaining reliability, performance, and operational excellence.

What you’ll do

As a TPM, you'll play a key role leading complex programs across multiple engineering, product, and cross-functional (finance, legal, compliance, risk, and other) teams spanning Bridge. You'll be an active contributor to the overall strategy of the program, drive technical decision-making, and drive the execution of the program through all phases from planning to delivery. You'll have the opportunity to implement mechanisms that make your programs effective and scale them to Bridge-level processes.

Responsibilities

Drive functional and technical delivery of key team and org-wide programs and initiatives.
Collaborate with engineering teams to design, scope, and shepherd features.
Create functional specs, project and release plans, and roadmaps.
Own and execute one or more software engineering programs simultaneously.
Drive product decisions that align with program and company objectives
Influence senior stakeholders and build consensus across engineering, product, and cross-functional teams
Define and scale program processes and frameworks that can be adopted across the org
Mentor TPMs and contribute to building the TPM discipline at Bridge

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in technical program or product management, with a consistent track record of shipping products with broad and global customer impact
You have a track record of providing solid program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to ship, demonstrating critical thinking and thought leadership throughout.
You're not satisfied with just delivering programs on time—you're discerning about product and infrastructure architecture and can lead technical discussions. You don’t let problems remain ambiguous and directly drive clarity on decision tradeoffs and solutions.
You operate independently and lead efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.
You have strong written and verbal communication skills to build relationships and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at a fintech or payments company. Track record of driving programs with cross-organizational or company-wide impact — not just team-level delivery. Comfortable working directly with senior engineering and product leadership with limited support. History of building toward durable, long-term solutions, not just shipping on time.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $208,200 - $312,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

This role is under Immediate Hiring.

Working at Thinking Machines

Thinking Machines is a technology consultancy building AI & data platforms to solve high-impact problems for our clients. Our vision is a future where data-driven decision-making is a norm and where AI is used to support humans in making excellent decisions. To do that, we create data cultures, one organization at a time.

We’re a company made up of intellectually curious, civic-minded, forever-learning individuals. We believe that great data science products are built with care for people and that the best way to drive inclusive innovation is to start with a diverse team.

Our field of work is incredibly dynamic, so we want to work with people who are committed to growing with us. We want to hire people who can demonstrate an ability to learn, then provide personalized coaching, growth opportunities, and a great working environment to get them to world-class.

Role Description

As a Project Manager, you are key in the successful and timely delivery of our data science projects. As our operations expand, so does the number of projects and their complexity. We deliver strategic projects for some of the largest organizations in Southeast Asia and having a dedicated project manager will allow us to take on more projects while maintaining the level of commitment and quality that our clients have come to expect from us.

You will be the main point of contact for our clients, keeping them informed of relevant milestones, blockers, or changes that a project needs. It’s not good to over or under-inform, so the project manager must be able to cascade the right information to the relevant people at the appropriate time.

You will be in charge of the projects’ schedule, requirements backlog, and to-do lists. Expect to work with both internal and client teams, and sometimes even push back on them, to keep the project on track -- effectively communicating at varying levels of seniority and contexts is a must. You will be expected to systematically break down big, vague requests into smaller, more actionable tasks for our teams. As such, being able to consolidate information from various parties and craft next steps from them will be very important.

Internally, you will be establishing workflows for your project teams depending on various factors like the nature of the project and the working style of your members. You need to quickly identify and improve on things that don’t work, as well as document and codify the things that do as best practices. The Project Manager is expected to create appropriate protocols, remove blockers, and address risks in a timely fashion, so that your team works at maximum efficiency. You must be able to build a strong rapport with your project teams. Making sure the project is delivered successfully through tough times while keeping your team motivated and not burnt out will be one of your most important responsibilities.

Requirements

Qualifications and competencies

We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

3+ years of project management experience - You must have successfully shipped or completed technology-focused products or software development projects.
Strong external communication skills - One of your main responsibilities will be to communicate with our client and internal teams of varying seniority. Not all news will be good news, so you need to know how to handle all sorts of situations.
A burning desire to get things done - You are the number one champion of your project, and you can rally your teammates to complete things on the task board.
Great adaptability and flexibility - Project plans, no matter how meticulously made, will veer off-course one way or another. You need to change strategies as needed, and not be locked into one way of doing things.
Ability to deal with ambiguity - You may handle projects that deal with topics you’ve never encountered before. You need to know how to ask the right questions to the right people to make things sensible for you and the team.
Quick learning ability - We don’t expect you to be an expert on the ins and outs of a data science project, but we do expect you to fill in the gaps quickly. Do the research and ask questions! You'll be part of a very talented team, so make sure to learn something new every day.
Strong initiative - There are many things to do from all sides! See something you can help with but you haven’t been assigned to? Go ahead and do it!

Ideal Candidates Have Experience With

Product design
Executing Agile methodologies

Additionally, we are requiring candidates to be flexible and willing to accommodate periodic face-to-face meetings with clients within Metro Manila
. While Thinking Machines operates as a remote-first company, certain project phases will require in-person interactions. As the main point of contact in client projects, Project Managers are expected to be the first to attend these on-site meetings.

Benefits

We offer the following compensation and benefits:

Competitive salary — the compensation amount is positively correlated with the difficulty of the job, relevant experience, fit, and skill factors.
Hybrid Set-Up — Hybrid-remote means employees are required to come in an average of two days a week for client engagements and internal in-person days intended for collaboration, socials, and strategic planning.
Individual professional development budget — an annual budget for conferences, training courses, books, and software is available to sharpen your skills and build new ones to help you grow in your role.
Full health benefits — generous health insurance package upon hiring, with options to include dependents.
Apprenticeship and yearly performance reviews with the leadership team to discuss career and personal goals, job progress and any questions and concerns.

17x Google Cloud Partner of the Year awards in the last 8 years.
3x AWS AI/ML award wins.
3x NVIDIA Partner of the Year titles.
2x Snowflake Partner of the Year awards.
We have also garnered top analyst recognitions from Gartner, ISG, and Everest Group.
We offer first-in-class industry solutions across Healthcare, Financial Services, Consumer Goods, Manufacturing, and more, powered by cutting-edge Generative AI and Agentic AI accelerators.
We have been certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row- 2021, 2022, 2023.

Be part of a trailblazing team that’s shaping the future of AI, ML, and cloud innovation.

Your next big opportunity starts here!

For more details, visit: Website or LinkedIn Page.

Experience Level:
10+ years of experience

Work Location:
EAST US

About The Role

Quantiphi is seeking a seasoned Technical Program Manager to drive the end-to-end delivery of cutting-edge Generative AI solutions. This role is ideal for a strategic and hands-on leader who can translate business needs into scalable AI architectures, while managing complex, multi-workstream programs across global teams.

You will lead high-impact initiatives focused on LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI systems owning delivery, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end execution of large-scale AI/ML programs, ensuring timely delivery of production-grade LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions
Define and drive program roadmaps, including PI planning, milestones, KPIs, and deliverables across multiple workstreams
Own program governance, risk management, and executive-level reporting on progress, outcomes, and ROI
Ensure strong alignment between technical delivery and client business objectives
Drive the design and implementation of scalable GenAI solutions, including RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows
Partner with architects and engineering teams to define infrastructure strategies, including GPU optimization, LLM hosting, and inference pipelines
Guide architectural decisions across model deployment, fine-tuning, and MLOps integration
Ensure adoption of best practices in AI governance, security, and responsible AI
Oversee implementation of modern AI stacks including LangChain, NVIDIA NeMo, and Triton Inference Server
Provide direction on vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB) and retrieval strategies
Guide optimization techniques such as quantization (GPTQ, AWQ), LoRA-based fine-tuning, and multi-GPU scaling
Support evaluation frameworks for model performance, accuracy, and efficiency
Act as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders, ensuring delivery aligns with contractual expectations and business goals
Build strong executive relationships and drive customer satisfaction, retention, and account growth
Lead cross-functional collaboration across data scientists, ML engineers, software developers, and consultants
Lead, mentor, and scale high-performing global teams
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning
Support career development and up-skilling of team members in emerging AI technologies

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5+ years leading AI/ML or data-driven initiatives
Proven track record managing complex, multiple work-stream programs with global teams
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills
Experience delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions with measurable business impact

Deep expertise in:

new_jobs.title: Global Quality Program Manager, Law Enforcement Operations - Trust and Safety
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the Team
Our Trust & Safety team's commitment is to keep our online community safe. Within Trust & Safety, our Law Enforcement Operations team (LEO), consists of the Emergency Response Team (ERT), the Child Safety Team (CST), the Law Enforcement Response Team (LERT), the Extreme Risk Operations Team (ERO) and the Intellectual Property Team (IP). These teams handle some of the most critical and time-sensitive operations on the platform.

About the Role
We are looking for a motivated, highly-analytical, and technically proficient Quality Program Manager . In this role, you will work with other internal teams to design, build, and scale a next-generation Quality Assurance (QA) and Compliance program. You will be responsible for safeguarding our most sensitive operational workflows—including Emergency Disclosures to Law Enforcement, standard Law Enforcement Disclosures, Child Safety operations (including NCMEC reporting), Extreme Risk Operations (ERO) and Intellectual Property (IP) Operations
You will leverage AI, machine learning, and automation to build automated auditing systems that continuously assess our end-to-end operational workflows help to detect anomalies or compliance risks in real-time, and drastically mitigate business, legal, and regulatory risks.

Responsibilities
- Architect the Quality Program in collaboration with cross functional partners: Design and implement a comprehensive scabable global quality framework specifically tailored for high-risk operations (LERT, ERT, CST, NCMEC reporting and IP operations).
- Build Automated QA Tools: Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to design, develop, and deploy internal AI-driven quality monitoring and auditing tools.
- Implement Anomaly Detection: Build innovative, scaled methods to detect and address quality warning signals across our end workflows.
- Mitigate Critical Risks: Proactively identify systemic vulnerabilities to prevent high risk quality failures that could impact the integrity of our operations and stakeholder trust.
- Perform Root Cause Analysis: Lead deep-dive investigations into quality failures or "near-misses," identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive action plans.
- Create Data-Driven Insights: Build automated dashboards and reporting pipelines to provide leadership with real-time visibility into compliance health and quality trends.
- Maintain Feedback Loops: Translate automated QA findings into actionable feedback, partnering with Team Leads to update training materials, operational policies, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
- Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all quality processes strictly align with global data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR), legal frameworks, and child safety regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Quality Assurance, Operational Risk, or Compliance, with at least 3 years specifically supporting Law Enforcement Response, Child Safety (CST), Emergency/Crisis Response operations and Intellectual Property Operations
- Hands-on technical proficiency with data and automation; strong, practical experience with SQL and Python (or similar scripting languages) to manipulate data, write basic automation scripts, and interface with engineering tools.
- Proven experience working with or implementing AI/ML-driven tools, natural language processing (NLP), or automated anomaly detection systems.
- Proven ability to analyze complex information to assess threat, compliance, and operational risk.
- Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Legal stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong communication, training, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical anomalies into clear business risks for non-technical leadership.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Law, Criminology, or a related quantitative/analytical field.
- Deep domain expertise in NCMEC reporting guidelines, global legal request processes, and emergency disclosure standards.
- Strong understanding of global data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) as they relate to law enforcement data disclosures.
- Your ability to work in a high-tempo environment, adapt, and respond to day-to-day challenges of the role.
- Your resilience and commitment to self-care to manage the emotional demands of the role.

Trust & Safety

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

new_jobs.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hou je van analytisch werk én van sociale interactie met consultants, klanten en leidinggevenden? Heb je een bewezen track record in projectmanagement binnen ERP-projecten en de maakindustrie? Wil je projecten en services van dichtbij opvolgen en echte impact maken in een complexe, digitale omgeving? Zoek je een plek waar je kan groeien, bijdragen aan innovatie en tegelijk je kennis van Microsoft Dynamics 365 en projectmanagement verder kan verdiepen? Dan is deze rol als Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO Project Manager
bij 9altitudes
wellicht jouw volgende stap.

Je dagelijkse avontuur

Als Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO Project Manager
ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor alle fases van implementatieprojecten en streef je naar continue verbetering van processen en resultaten.

Je bewaakt de scope, het budget en de projectplanning en volgt deze rigoureus op van project naar project.
Je staat garant voor hoogwaardige projectoplevering en zorgt voor maximale tevredenheid van de klant.
Je fungeert als Trusted Advisor en vormt de brug tussen de operationele processen van klanten en de mogelijkheden van Microsoft Dynamics 365, waarbij je behoeften vertaalt naar schaalbare digitale oplossingen.
Je stuurt projectteams aan, motiveert en coacht teamleden, en zorgt dat iedereen op één lijn zit met de projectdoelstellingen.
Je organiseert regelmatig projectgesprekken en klantvergaderingen, bijstuurt waar nodig en neemt proactief beslissingen om projecten op koers te houden.
Je rapporteert duidelijk aan het PMO Management over voortgang, budget en risico’s.
Je draagt bij aan een cultuur van verbetering en optimalisatie, zodat elk project succesvoller en efficiënter verloopt dan het vorige.

Vaardigheden

Je bent Master of een ervaren Bachelor met gelijkwaardig kennisniveau, aangevuld met minstens 5 jaar ervaring in projectmanagement bij de implementatie van IT- en bedrijfsoplossingen
Je hebt ervaring met ERP-projecten, bij voorkeur binnen de maakindustrie
Je hebt inzicht in één of meerdere businessprocessen: logistiek, productie, planning, warehouse management, verkoop, aankoop, financiën, project accounting
Je bent PRINCE2 Foundation en ITIL v4 Foundation gecertificeerd en/of bent bereid je hierin bij te scholen.
Je hebt een hands-on mentaliteit, neemt ownership over projectenen begrijpt de uitdagingen en noden tijdens transformatie- en implementatietrajecten.
Je bent vlot in Nederlands en Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk)

Je travelpack wordt gevuld met

Aantrekkelijk verloningspakket: competitief salaris, extralegale voordelen zoals hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques en een elektrische firmawagen met laadpas.
Personaliseer je eindejaarspremie via het 9A Flexplan: extra laptop, bureaustoel of andere opties die voor jou waardevol zijn.
Werk-privébalans & flexibiliteit: we helpen je een gezond evenwicht te vinden tussen werk en privé, met de mogelijkheid tot hybride werken (thuis of op kantoor: Antwerpen, Gent, Kortrijk).
Een uitgebreide onboarding en een persoonlijk opleidingstraject: Stel samen met je teamlead een gepersonaliseerd groeipad op, afhankelijk van jouw ambities en interesses.
Ontdek en groei binnen de “9A-community”, waar kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om certificaten en opleidingen te volgen.
Afwisselende opdrachten: projecten bij diverse klanten met een focus op de maakindustrie.
Werk samen met collega’s over de landsgrenzen heen binnen de 9altitudes-groep en leer van best practices uit verschillende landen.
Versterk de band met je collega’s tijdens verbindende events zoals het nieuwjaars- en zomerevent, de jaarlijkse quiz, business updates/afterworks, de Family Day en de Elevate Together Day.
Bijdragen aan groei: speel een actieve rol in het succes en de uitbreiding van 9altitudes-activiteiten in België en Europa.
Word onderdeel van een innovatieve werkcontext met de nieuwste technologieën, binnen een Microsoft Gold en Scale Fast Partner.

Neem contact op

Bij 9altitudes
krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de internationale voorloper op technologie en procesoptimalisatie. Met meer dan 750 collega’s in 9 landen combineren we diepgaande expertise in o.a. ERP, CE, BI & AI, Document Management, PLM, IoT & Augmented Reality, CAD en eCommerce. Samen creëren we meer dan oplossingen: we leveren échte waarde en zetten mee de toon voor duurzame resultaten bij onze klanten.

Klaar om met ons mee te groeien en je carrière naar nieuwe hoogtes te tillen? Zet vandaag nog de eerste stap in jouw nieuwe avontuur en solliciteer eenvoudig via onze website.

Wil je zien hoe wij samen grenzen verleggen, innovatieve business solutions creëren en hoogtepunten vieren? Volg ons dan op LinkedIn
en blijf op de hoogte van onze projecten, successen en events.

new_jobs.title: IT Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
How to Apply

A cover letter and resume are important submissions for the hiring team to get a sense of your experience. In the cover letter, in one page or less, please let us know how this role aligns with your career aspirations and skills. Submit both a cover letter and resume as one file.

Competitive salary available based on qualifications, experience and education of the selected candidate.

Job Summary

Information and Technology Services (ITS) at the University of Michigan-Ann Arbor is seeking a Senior Project Manager
to join the ITS Project Management Office. ITS supports the university's academic, research, and administrative missions by delivering secure, innovative, and reliable technology services across Ann Arbor, Michigan Medicine, and the Flint and Dearborn campuses.

We are looking for an experienced project management professional who thrives in a dynamic, rapidly evolving technology environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong customer service and relationship-building skills, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to think both strategically and tactically. This role requires effectively managing priorities, meeting deadlines, and ensuring the successful delivery of project outcomes.

Key Responsibilities Include

Delivering a wide variety of complex technology projects ranging from software development, IT infrastructure, vendor product implementation, and process transformation.
Ensuring successful project outcomes by partnering closely with cross-functional teams, sponsors, and stakeholders across both the Information Technology Services (ITS) organization and the entire university community.

This position reports directly to the VPIP-CIO Chief of Staff and IT Project Management Office Director.

Responsibilities*

Project Management

Oversee complex technology projects to ensure that they are completed on time, within budget, and according to agreed-upon scope and quality standards.
Ensure service owners are aware of and adhere to the ITS service life cycle process and have a plan to maintain the service after the project is completed.
Develop detailed project schedules, in collaboration with the project team, that account for all deliverables, workstreams, milestones, estimated effort, resource plans, and financial budgets.
Ensure a common understanding of project goals and outcomes with the project team and all project stakeholders.
Actively identify and anticipate potential risks, develop mitigation plans, and drive the resolution of project issues.
Apply organizational change management techniques to ensure successful project outcomes.
Form the project team and ensure that clearly defined roles and responsibilities are established for the duration of the project and the resulting operational outcomes.
Assess project performance with team members and stakeholders by identifying areas for improvement, implementing innovations, and leading corrective actions as necessary.
Ensure effective communication and collaboration across all project team members, ITS leadership, and project stakeholders. Deliver weekly project status reports and establish additional project communication tactics as necessary.
Build consensus. Challenge proposals when appropriate.
Demonstrate strong influencing and negotiation skills with the ability to lead project teams through creative problem-solving.
Establish and maintain trust, facilitate cooperation, and create strong relationships at all levels: customer, stakeholder, executive, management, and staff.
Demonstrate robust knowledge of IT principles, standards, and processes.

Strategy and Planning

Act as a trusted advisor to leadership and support future strategy outcomes.
Leverage data to guide decision-making, perform risk analysis, craft compelling stories that resonate with an executive audience, and present information to all levels through graphical representations.
Assess impacts and trade-offs of key decisions, including financial, customer, reputation, effort, and ongoing operations.

Leadership & Development of Self and Others

Ability to navigate complex and ambiguous circumstances to drive project progress.
Stay updated on relevant advances in business and technology; seek opportunities to diversify skills and experience.

Title:
Senior Engineering Project Manager

Company:
Heven AeroTech

Location:
Bingen, Washington

About Our Company

At Heven AeroTech (Heven), we don’t just believe in the power of people—we build our success on it. As a recognized leader in hydrogen-powered drones, we’ve earned recognition for creating a workplace where innovation thrives, collaboration is second nature, and every employee feels valued. Our culture is anchored in trust and a shared commitment to excellence.

We believe great teams are built on individuals who are humble, hungry, and smart—those who put team success first, take initiative to continuously improve, and demonstrate strong interpersonal awareness. At Heven, your voice matters, your ideas are heard, and your contributions make a tangible impact as you grow through hands-on experience and collaboration across the team.

Role Summary

Heven AeroTech is seeking a Senior Engineering Project Manager to plan, coordinate, and drive the technical execution of our unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) engineering programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and program management: you will own the integrated technical schedule, translate systems engineering and design requirements into executable work plans, and keep multidisciplinary engineering teams (airframe, propulsion, avionics, software, and payload) aligned against cost, schedule, and technical performance targets. Beyond running individual programs, you will build and continuously improve the engineering project management processes, tools, and gating criteria that the broader organization uses to deliver UAS hardware and software from concept through flight test and production. Success in this role requires genuine technical fluency — the ability to read requirements and drawings, understand test data, and engage credibly in engineering design reviews — combined with strong program management discipline.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead technical project management for one or more UAS engineering programs, spanning airframe/structures, propulsion, avionics, flight software, and payload integration workstreams.
Develop and maintain the integrated master schedule (IMS), work breakdown structure (WBS), and critical path analysis; proactively identify schedule risk and drive recovery plans.
Partner with systems engineering to translate requirements, interface control documents, and verification plans into actionable engineering task plans and staffing assignments.
Plan and facilitate technical design reviews and program milestones (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, flight readiness reviews), including agenda development, entrance/exit criteria, and action item tracking to closure.
Own program-level technical risk and opportunity management: identify, quantify, track, and drive mitigation of engineering risks in coordination with discipline leads.
Manage engineering change requests and configuration control in support of the company's design change (PDCR) process, ensuring changes are scoped, reviewed, and communicated to affected teams.
Develop, standardize, and continuously improve engineering project management processes, templates, and tools (scheduling, requirements traceability, risk registers, metrics/dashboards) across programs.
Manage program technical budget and resource allocation; support staffing plans and headcount forecasting in coordination with engineering leads.
Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and test/flight operations to ensure engineering deliverables support build, integration, and flight test schedules.
Interface directly with internal leadership and external customers/partners to communicate technical status, risks, and trade-offs; prepare and deliver program reviews and status reporting.
Support compliance with applicable engineering standards, airworthiness, and regulatory requirements (e.g., FAA Part 107/UAS regulations, relevant MIL-STD or RTCA/DO guidance) as they apply to program execution.
Drive lessons-learned capture and process retrospectives at program milestones to feed continuous improvement of engineering execution practices.
Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written) is required to perform the responsibilities of this role.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
If this role requires access to information controlled under U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR), applicants must also qualify as a "U.S. person" under 22 CFR
120.62 (U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee).
Other duties as assigned.

Required

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
4–10 years of experience in engineering project management, technical program management, or systems engineering, ideally within UAS, aerospace, or defense product development.
Demonstrated technical fluency: able to read and interpret engineering drawings, requirements documents, interface control documents, and test/analysis data well enough to plan work and challenge technical assumptions.
Proven experience building and maintaining integrated schedules (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet) and work breakdown structures for multidisciplinary hardware/software programs.
Experience managing technical risk registers, action item tracking, and design review gating (PDR/CDR-type milestones).
Track record of developing or improving engineering project management processes, templates, or tools within an organization.
Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting technical status to engineering leadership and customers.
Working knowledge of configuration management and engineering change control processes.

Preferred

Master's degree in an engineering discipline or a technical MBA.
PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification.
Direct experience on UAS, drone, or other aerospace/defense flight vehicle programs.
Familiarity with systems engineering lifecycle practices (requirements management, V&V/test planning, MBSE tools).
Experience with PLM/ALM tooling (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, Jira, Confluence) and requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS, Jama).
Familiarity with FAA UAS regulations, airworthiness processes, or relevant military/commercial aviation standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-160, MIL-STD-810).
Experience with earned value management (EVM) or similar program performance metrics

Physical Requirements

Ability to work in both office and engineering lab environments for extended periods.
Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for prolonged periods throughout the workday.
Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds of engineering equipment, prototypes, test hardware, or program materials.
Ability to attend and participate in engineering design reviews, manufacturing floor activities, integration events, and flight test operations.
Ability to travel domestically up to 20% of the time, with occasional international travel as required.
Ability to access manufacturing, test, and flight operations environments, including navigating hangars, workshops, and outdoor test sites.
Ability to visually inspect engineering drawings, schedules, technical documentation, hardware, and test data.
Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and through virtual collaboration tools.

Benefits Overview

Heven AeroTech offers a competitive benefits package designed to support the health, financial security, and overall well-being of our employees and their families. Benefits in protectional, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off/sick, and additional protections such as critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident coverage, and short- and long-term disability.

About The Company

Veteran Workforce Solutions is a leading organization dedicated to supporting the transition of military service members into civilian careers. With a strong emphasis on workforce development and skill enhancement, the company partners with various industry leaders to create meaningful employment opportunities for veterans. Their mission is to bridge the gap between military experience and civilian job markets by providing targeted training, mentorship, and career placement services. Veteran Workforce Solutions prides itself on fostering an inclusive environment that values discipline, technical expertise, and leadership qualities inherent in military personnel, ensuring they find rewarding roles that leverage their unique skills and experiences.

About The Role

The Cybersecurity Analyst internship offered through Veteran Workforce Solutions is an immersive 16-week SkillBridge program designed specifically for transitioning service members with backgrounds in cyber operations, signals intelligence, or IT. Participants will gain practical, hands-on experience working alongside civilian cybersecurity professionals within a reputable employer partner organization. The role involves supporting critical security functions such as threat detection, vulnerability management, and incident response, all under the mentorship of industry experts. This position provides a comprehensive pathway into the cybersecurity field, emphasizing skill development, industry certifications, and potential full-time employment upon successful completion. The program aims to equip participants with the technical acumen and professional readiness needed to excel in the rapidly evolving cybersecurity landscape.

Qualifications

Active-duty service members within 180 days of separation or retirement are eligible to apply.
Must have approval from the unit commanding officer to participate in the DoD SkillBridge program.
Background in cyber operations, signals intelligence, IT systems, or network administration is preferred.
Relevant Military Occupational Specialty (MOS), rate, or Air Force Specialty Code (AFSC): 17C, 25B, 35Q, CTN, 1B4, 3D0X2, 1N4, 0651.
Active Secret clearance is preferred but not required.
Ability to operate effectively in remote or hybrid work environments.
No prior civilian cybersecurity certification is necessary; training and certifications will be provided during the program.

Responsibilities

Participants will work closely with seasoned cybersecurity professionals to support a variety of security operations. Key responsibilities include monitoring security alerts and logs to identify potential threats, managing Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems, conducting vulnerability scans to identify system weaknesses, and assisting in incident response activities to mitigate security breaches. The role involves participating in threat hunting exercises and simulated incident response scenarios to develop practical skills. Throughout the program, participants will engage in structured training modules covering the cybersecurity threat landscape, SOC operations, vulnerability management, and industry-standard certifications such as CompTIA Sec+, CEH, or CISSP. The participant will also prepare a capstone project, such as a threat hunt or incident response simulation, demonstrating their ability to apply learned skills in real-world scenarios. Regular performance reviews and mentorship sessions will support personal and professional growth, culminating in a debrief and employment discussion at the program’s conclusion.

Benefits

Participants in the Cybersecurity Analyst SkillBridge program will gain valuable industry experience, technical skills, and professional certifications that enhance their employability in the cybersecurity sector. The program offers networking opportunities with industry professionals and potential full-time employment upon successful completion. Additionally, veterans will receive mentorship and guidance from experienced cybersecurity experts, helping to establish a solid foundation for a career in cybersecurity. The organization also provides resources for career development, resume building, and interview preparation. As a participant, you will be part of a supportive community committed to your success, with access to ongoing training and educational opportunities designed to keep your skills current in this dynamic field.

Equal Opportunity

Veteran Workforce Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and program participants. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Our commitment is to provide equal access to employment, training, and development opportunities, ensuring all individuals have the chance to succeed and grow within our organization and partner networks.

Company Description
Neighborhood Housing Services of New York City, Inc. (NHSNYC) is a non-profit, HUD-certified housing counseling agency dedicated to revitalizing underserved neighborhoods and preserving affordable housing across New York City. Founded in 1982, NHSNYC is guided by local residents and community needs, focusing its impact in Bedford-Stuyvesant, East Flatbush, the North Bronx, Northern Queens, and the South Bronx. As a chartered member of NeighborWorks® America and a federally-certified Community Development Finance Institution (CDFI), NHSNYC is part of a national network of affordable housing and community development organizations. The organization offers homeownership counseling and education, down-payment assistance and lending, financial literacy education, foreclosure intervention, home maintenance training, home repair and rehabilitation lending, and community engagement activities. Applicants can learn more about NHSNYC and its programs at www.nhsnyc.org and through its social media channels.

The Housing Project Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in New York, NY. This role oversees affordable housing and community development projects from planning through completion, ensuring that timelines, budgets, and regulatory requirements are met. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams, community partners, contractors, and public agencies; managing project schedules and documentation; and monitoring progress to ensure quality and compliance. The Housing Project Manager will support program delivery by preparing reports, tracking key performance indicators, and maintaining accurate project records. The role also involves engaging with residents and stakeholders, addressing project-related concerns, and contributing to strategies that enhance neighborhood stability and housing affordability.

Project management skills, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management for housing or construction-related initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Bridge
new_jobs.description:
Who we are

About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About The Team

Join our Technical Program Management team to build the systems that make global, programmable money trustworthy at scale. At Bridge, we’re not just improving global payments—we’re reinventing how money moves across borders using stablecoins and modern financial infrastructure.

This role is about driving execution across complex technical initiatives—bringing structure to ambiguous problems, aligning stakeholders, and helping the team move quickly while maintaining reliability, performance, and operational excellence.

What you’ll do

As a TPM, you'll play a key role leading complex programs across multiple engineering, product, and cross-functional (finance, legal, compliance, risk, and other) teams spanning Bridge. You'll be an active contributor to the overall strategy of the program, drive technical decision-making, and drive the execution of the program through all phases from planning to delivery. You'll have the opportunity to implement mechanisms that make your programs effective and scale them to Bridge-level processes.

Responsibilities

Drive functional and technical delivery of key team and org-wide programs and initiatives.
Collaborate with engineering teams to design, scope, and shepherd features.
Create functional specs, project and release plans, and roadmaps.
Own and execute one or more software engineering programs simultaneously.
Drive product decisions that align with program and company objectives
Influence senior stakeholders and build consensus across engineering, product, and cross-functional teams
Define and scale program processes and frameworks that can be adopted across the org
Mentor TPMs and contribute to building the TPM discipline at Bridge

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in technical program or product management, with a consistent track record of shipping products with broad and global customer impact
You have a track record of providing solid program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to ship, demonstrating critical thinking and thought leadership throughout.
You're not satisfied with just delivering programs on time—you're discerning about product and infrastructure architecture and can lead technical discussions. You don’t let problems remain ambiguous and directly drive clarity on decision tradeoffs and solutions.
You operate independently and lead efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.
You have strong written and verbal communication skills to build relationships and collaborate with diverse cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at a fintech or payments company. Track record of driving programs with cross-organizational or company-wide impact — not just team-level delivery. Comfortable working directly with senior engineering and product leadership with limited support. History of building toward durable, long-term solutions, not just shipping on time.

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $208,200 - $312,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

new_jobs.title: Project Manager F/H
new_jobs.description:
Freyssinet, l'expertise au service des ouvrages d'exception

Depuis plus de 80 ans, Freyssinet est un acteur majeur du génie civil spécialisé dans les technologies de construction, de réparation et de maintenance des ouvrages. Présent dans plus de 60 pays et filiale du groupe VINCI Construction, Freyssinet intervient sur des projets emblématiques à travers le monde grâce à son expertise technique et sa capacité d'innovation.

Nos équipes imaginent et réalisent des solutions uniques pour relever les défis les plus complexes du secteur de la construction et des infrastructures.

Hebetec
: l'ingénierie du levage et de la manutention lourde

Au sein du groupe Freyssinet, Hebetec est spécialisée dans les opérations de levage, de transport et de manutention lourde. Nous accompagnons nos clients sur des projets hors normes nécessitant des solutions sur mesure pour déplacer, lever ou installer des charges exceptionnelles.

Ponts, équipements industriels, structures métalliques, éléments préfabriqués ou ouvrages d'art : chaque projet est unique et demande créativité, rigueur et innovation.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de Projet / Project Manager.

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) au Head of Operations, vous pilotez vos projets de A à Z et représentez HEBETEC auprès de nos clients.

À ce titre, vous êtes notamment chargé(e) de :

assurer la relation client et la coordination des interfaces chantier ;

organiser, préparer et suivre l’exécution des travaux ;

coordonner les équipes, les sous-traitants et les moyens matériels ;

garantir le respect des délais, du budget et des engagements contractuels ;

identifier et négocier les travaux supplémentaires (Variation Orders) ;

assurer le reporting projet auprès de la direction opérationnelle ;

veiller à la bonne clôture des opérations et à l’obtention des réceptions.

Sécurité, Qualité, Environnement

Vous êtes un acteur clé de la culture QHSE du Groupe :

mise en œuvre du plan QHSE projet ;

application et contrôle des procédures sécurité et qualité ;

validation des analyses de risques ;

traitement des non-conformités et amélioration continue ;

respect des réglementations locales et des exigences clients.

Diplôme d’Ingénieur (Bac+5) ou équivalent.
Minimum 8 ans d’expérience dans le BTP / génie civil.
Expérience chantier significative, idéalement dans les travaux spécialisés.
Une expérience au sein de Freyssinet, HEBETEC ou d’un environnement similaire est un plus.
Anglais professionnel apprécié.

Les qualités qui feront la différence

Leadership et sens du terrain.

Organisation et capacité d’anticipation.

Culture sécurité forte.

Sens du client et esprit entrepreneurial.

Capacité à piloter un projet dans sa globalité : technique, planning, budget et contrat.

Aisance relationnelle et capacité à fédérer des équipes multiculturelles.

Participer à des projets uniques et spectaculaires
Évoluer dans un environnement mêlant ingénierie, innovation et terrain
Travailler sur des solutions sur mesure à forte valeur technique
Rejoindre un groupe international reconnu pour son expertise
Développer rapidement vos compétences et vos responsabilités

new_jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will work onsite with product, engineering, and AI teams to turn product, job market, and user data into insights that directly influence product development.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product, user, and job market data to identify trends and opportunities
• Write SQL queries and build reports, dashboards, and analytical tools
• Define and monitor key product and business metrics
• Support A/B tests and evaluate new product features
• Investigate data quality issues and improve reporting accuracy
• Present findings to product, engineering, and business stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with the team in an onsite environment
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate or graduating soon in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field
• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with spreadsheets or Python
• Understanding of basic statistics, data analysis, and experimentation
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work onsite in the SF Bay Area

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search
• Experience working with large or messy datasets
• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience
